delivery.title: She Wasn't Afraid of Being Alone—She Was Afraid of Loving Again

bespoke.notes: Hand-authored composition: 8 bespoke beats, custom grain/type system, no stock cut.type scenes, no RENDERER_FAMILY_MAP.

cuts.label: THE TAKEAWAY
cuts.note: clip runs out at 8.00 s; last frame held under the closing question

decision_log.subject: Composition runtime
decision_log.rejected_because: HyperFrames is not installed in this sandbox (no npm hyperframes runtime) and ffmpeg cannot express the per-word caption timing, grain system and graphics draw-on; Remotion 4.0.484 + the OpenMontage composer is available and renders the bespoke TSX entry directly.

decision_log.subject: Authoring mode
decision_log.rejected_because: Hero single-deliverable; the stock cut.type catalog (text_card/stat_card/…) would reintroduce the sameness the piece is trying to avoid.

decision_log.subject: Narration TTS provider
options_considered: piper-tts (offline, no mature American female model verified)
decision_log.notes: 10 stems generated, then trimmed on detected speech bounds, high-passed, compressed 2.2:1 and normalised to -18 LUFS each.

decision_log.subject: Score
options_considered: library track (blocked: no licensable source reachable)
decision_log.rejected_because: No reachable royalty-free library; score is generated additively (inharmonic partials, felt-piano envelope, synthetic hall IR) so it is licence-free and beat-locked to the edit.

decision_log.subject: Runtime
decision_log.rejected_because: 94 words of measured narration = 37.3 s of speech; the script's own pause requirements (pre/post question, hesitation hold, 1.5-2 s on-screen question) do not fit inside 40 s. Fitting 40 s would mean cutting the pauses that carry the story.

decision_log.subject: Footage treatment
decision_log.rejected_because: Delivery spec is vertical Shorts at 1080x1920; regeneration was out of scope for this task and the 8 supplied clips are the approved footage.

graphics.content: What she knew || What she risked
Would you like to get dinner this Friday?
Yes / Not yet / No — cursor drifts to No, retreats
Then: someone else's choice / Now: her own judgement
1 of 9 — one coffee, not a promise
Would you give love another chance?

captions.source: burned-in, per-word timed, derived from measured narration
